_comment: How each speaker addresses the player and, where it matters, other characters. Format: docs/glossary.md of ffxiv-corpus-en.
player is «tu» or «voi»; «Lei» is never used. Spanish tú maps to tu and usted to voi, so corpus-es/glossary/register.json decides a speaker it already measured.
why names the source that settled it: the Spanish file, the Japanese (number and the cases French defaults away from) or the French (formality).

AIDE.why: Seasoned adventurer at the Hall of the Novice. fr vous, ja keigo.

ALIANNE.why: No second person in the French; ja plain endings.

AMALJAA.why: Plural addressee throughout: ordinary plural voi, archaic lexicon.

ARMELLE.why: fr vous 3/0; a clerk courting a customer.

AVERE.why: Edda's party among themselves: fr tu, ja お前/てめぇ.

BRASSSENTRY.why: Two characters under one key: the loyal sentry says voi (fr vous, ja 様); the traitors from row 500 on say tu (fr tu, ja plain). Decided per row.

CICIDOA.voice: Alliterates heavily in English; carried where it falls naturally, never forced.

DOLOROUSBEAR.why: fr vous, ja 君; tu inside his own party. Theatrical knight-errant, voi carries the pose.

FLAMEPRIVATE.why: fr vous 11/2 across the Flames ranks.

FLAMESGT.why: fr vous 11/2 across the Flames ranks.

FLAMESOLDIER.why: fr vous 11/2 across the Flames ranks.

FUFULUPA.why: fr vous 31/1, ja ます x50.

IFRIT.why: By rule: no voi from a primal to a mortal. fr vous 10/0 overridden; English thou/thee sets the archaic lexicon.

ISILDAURE.why: fr vous 2/0, but ja お前さん with じゃろ dialect: an old adventurer to a colleague. The Japanese decides.

KEITHA.why: fr vous 5/0, ja です x5 plus いただけますか.

KODOMOA.why: Stonesthrow children, KODOMOA to KODOMOD: fr vous, English mister/missus. Tu from a child to an adult stranger reads modern.

LEONNIE.why: fr vous, ja です/ます, ください.

MASKEDMAGUS.why: An Ascian speaking down; fr third person.

MERILDA.why: fr vous 3/0, ja です x5.

MOMODI.why: corpus-es/register.json tú; her French vous 77/3 is overridden by it.

OSHAJAAB.why: fr vous; ja 君 answers number only.

REYNER.why: fr tu 5/0, ja 君. A commodore who greets the player as a returning friend.

ROGER.why: fr vous, but ja plain and rough, English laddie/lassie. The Japanese decides.

TEMUGGZOH.why: Amalj'aa priest: capitalised Tu to Ifrit as Italian scripture addresses God; plural voi to the captives. Archaic lexicon and inversion.

VMELLPA.why: fr vous, ja 冒険者殿 plus ください.

WYRKRHIT.why: fr tu; ja keigo, but the French answers formality and the English gives him ye/yer.

WYSTAN.why: fr tu 22/4, ja 君; the four vous are inconsistent within one scene.

YELLOWJACKET.why: The guard at Sastasha: fr tu, ja お前.

ZUZUMEDA.why: fr vous 10/2 against ja あんた; the French answers formality, and voi suits a merchant courting a listener.
